entry.title: We wrote 25 Matrix bridges in 7 languages, and we did not get to choose
entry.summary:
What happens when you stop picking a stack and let each protocol pick one for you. Every engineering team has a stack. Ours has seven, and we did not decide on any of them. Nevai is a self-hosted, end-to-end encrypted workspace built on Matrix. entry.title: A planet in a browser tab
entry.summary: Our site now has a chapter where you scroll a camera through low orbit, visiting the four places we operate from. It looks like it should weigh fifty megabytes. It ships in roughly 1.5, and it is built almost entirely from public-domain science data. The planet is NASA Blue Marble imagery, resized and recompressed by a build-time generator. Never hand-edited: when we want a change, we change the generator and bake again. City lights are not a texture. A script samples a NASA night-lights raster into about 46,000 weighted points packed into a small binary buffer, rendered as glowing sprites. Crisp at any zoom, because they are geometry, not pixels.
